General
* A clash of code with the same task already exists:
https://www.codingame.com/contribute/view/155608a50ea8b87dd001bc28144bb8530d5aa

Please use another idea for your contribution.

* When designing test cases, please make use of the full range of values set in the constraints.

The current constraints are:
• 2 ≤ N ≤ 1000
• -10^9 ≤ target ≤ 10^9
• -10^9 ≤ nums[i] ≤ 10^9

However, in the current test set:
• N never exceeds 100.
• All but one pair of cases use values between -100 and 100 for both target and nums[i].

As a result, the cases don't adequately cover the stated range of values. Please avoid this in future contributions.

Thanks.
